data.turoyo: Məlla: “De lwašu aǧ ǧulaṯxu!” Mədde, lwəšše laǧ ǧulaṯṯe w lu rəhal dəṯṯe. W məlla: “De mudu lab baxčkaṯxu, maḥetənne taḥte da fṣeṭən dəṯxu w maṣiru ḥaṣayxu aʕlayye!”
data.translation: So, nun zieht euer Kleid er an! - Sie zogen ihre Kleider und Siebensachen an. - Nun nehmt eure Kleiderbündel, steckt sie euch unter die Röcke und gürtet darüber eure Hüftenfest! -

summary: Active binding takes a zero-marked patient NP or object suffix, with b- for a tether, material or attachment support; ʕal marks surfaces/body parts, l- can mark a support or overt agent, and b-ḥḏoḏe / ʕam ḥḏoḏe relates multiple patients. Do not equate these prepositions with new meanings automatically.

Reflexive ruḥ- expressions remain active III; plural patients tied together do not by themselves establish Detransitive morphology. Detransitive Infectum describes agentless assembly or hitching; Part. Pass. describes a continuing bound configuration.

The new Preterit-wa and Infectum-wa boxes contrast anterior dressing with habitual binding; the source English/German tense does not determine the Turoyo box. Animal antecedents of the short MAC Infectum-wa examples are supplied in the surrounding verses.
